parts.one_line: Test performance, against the product profile's performance level: the running build is measured in the testing environment, as one person meets it and under the load its pass bar names, against the performance level the product profile commits to, and each finding goes back to the developer or to a person.

Once the built work runs in the testing environment, measures on each declared surface, by a part that is not the builder, what the pass bar and each capability's performance need name, as one person or one other system meets the product there, and records each figure with the conditions it was measured in.

When the pass bar or a capability's performance need names a load, puts that load on the running build with made-up users, in the environment the deployment design places the load tests in and at its declared size, measures what the bar names under it, and never sends load outside that environment.

Gives one verdict for the built work against the profile's performance level, with a pass or a fail for every part of the pass bar and each capability's performance need, and sends each finding back as a handoff plan to the developer when the builder can fix it alone, or to the product owner when a person must decide.

Runs the performance tests again after a fix, when more work is built, when an approved decision raises the performance level, and when the environment the tests run in changes size, keeps each verdict, names what passed before and fails now, and sends a finding that keeps coming back to a person once the rounds the project allows are used up.
